Why a Master of Arts in Interreligious Dialogue?

  • Fully available online with recorded lectures
  • Clear focus on the world's main religions and their fundamentals
  • Provides deep knowledge of different cultural and religious contexts
  • Offers the opportunity to dialogue with people of diverse religious beliefs
  • Stands out for the international stature of its Professors
  • Guarantees personal tutors for regular feedback and guidance
  • Provides the opportunity to apply for scholarships

"The Master of Arts in Interreligious Dialogue program has been a transformative journey for me. It deepened my understanding of diverse religions, honed my communication skills, and equipped me to promote a peaceful coexistence in our world. The engaging lectures and practical reflections made this program truly enriching. I am grateful for the opportunity to actively contribute to an interreligious dialogue."

(II year student of the MA)
